name: Deacon
overview: The role of a deacon in Scripture is fundamentally one of service, as the Greek word diakonos means servant or minister, emphasizing humble ministry rather than authority. Early in the church, deacons were selected by the people and ordained by the apostles to address practical needs, such as caring for widows, so the apostles could focus on prayer and the ministry of the Word. Qualifications for deacons included being men of honest report, filled with the Holy Spirit and wisdom, highlighting the spiritual and moral character required for this servant leadership. Christ-centered service is foundational, as greatness in the kingdom is expressed through humble ministry to others.
